posts.text: I live in East TN. When the COVID vaccines started becoming available, folks would specifically ask for the “Dolly vaccine” aka the Moderna one she donated money to help develop. I still call it the “Dolly vaccine” to this day when I get a booster, and the medical staff always knows what I mean.
